notes.title: Announcement about delayed update during this period
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am Pi Zai, the producer of "Real Estate Tycoon". First of all, I would like to say sorry to all the players who are looking forward to our game. I can't continue to update the game faster and better.

A few days ago, due to power outages, epidemics and other reasons, as well as sales that could not cover the team’s salary costs, our studio had to go bankrupt as a last resort, and part of the money we earned before was given to the investor to let him recover the cost. The previous 5 people There are only two people left in the team, but we will not give up on this game. I am currently recruiting engineers for the Unreal Engine. I have already approached and chatted with two of them, but their experience is not enough to control the complex aspects of this game. Code structure, but we will continue to recruit. I promise everyone that I will not give up on this game. There are also many games in foreign countries whose EA period has lasted for many years, and each team is struggling to maintain its own operation, desperately resisting all kinds of difficulties and obstacles that arise at any time.

On the eve of bankruptcy, we were also trying to make a creative workshop, but it still failed. Compared with the common unity engine on the market, the Unreal Engine creative workshop has many difficult technical difficulties to overcome. It took us a month to make it, but it was only Figured out half of the process.

Next, after recruiting people to restore the update, I will give priority to making translations, business chains and business war content to ensure that the simulated business part has a richer game experience, and then switch to the official version before deciding whether to update the rpg content. The main reason was that we could only hire one experienced Unreal engineer with the money we had.

Compared with the planned EA period of 3-6 months, we have to extend this period. Here, I would like to express my sincere thanks to all the players who support me. Thank you for your cheers, encouragement and rewards It has given us greater strength and hope. I believe that our current difficulties are temporary, and we are still full of hope for the future.

Please give us some time and be patient, thank you~

notes.title: update（）
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! I'm Pi Zai, the producer. Our update was delayed for a long time due to power failure, epidemic isolation, and illness of members. I apologize for this. Finally, in the morning of October 1, we successfully updated the version. Thank you for your support and waiting. Our game functionality is more complete, and there is still a lot of room for improvement in gameplay. We will do our best, Try to update a more playable simulated business version before November.
Update content:
1. The blueprint function of small family and the copying, moving and uploading of rooms have been added. (The algorithm is extremely complex, and the sim is also a function that comes out in later generations.)
2. The indoor label has been redesigned. The indoor label needs to be used in conjunction with the room type to make the indoor play more playful. (but more complicated)
3. Add labels to outdoor buildings.
4. Added some furniture and sexy clothes.
5. The difficulty adjuster is added to the opening option.
6. The display of some functions being made has been added. (The characters walk in the room, interact with the bed and other NPCs simply, and haven't picked up the RPG playing methods that were cut off before, just for display)
7. The value has been adjusted (it is not a complete adjustment. After more outdoor labels are updated next time, a big adjustment will be made to the phenomenon that money has been made in the late game to make the late game more challenging)
8. Fixed the bug that late archiving would crash.
9. Fixed a bug that occasionally failed to increase the disaster relief score.
10. Adjusted the markup of employees on the company's construction cost. Now, the company+employees can only deduct 30% of the construction cost at most.
11. The amount of money for novice guidance has been changed to 1 billion, so that new players will not have to experience the basic process again in the new game after finishing the novice guidance.
Next, we are going to make a creative workshop for model import. The UE4 engine has poor support for the creative workshop, and we are not sure whether we can make it. But for games like ours, the creative workshop is very important. Let's try our best to make it.
The next update will also make a larger adjustment to the value to ensure that the game has enough challenges in the late stage.
